dataset: Certificate "To Whom It May Concern" for Zakat Assistance

source.organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat
source.methodology: A database containing the names of the Authority's services and total transaction statistics provided during the year 2025, classified by month

indicator.name: Statistics of Certificate "To Whom It May Concern" for Zakat Assistance
indicator.definition: A report reviewing the number of customers by channel and month

smartphone_app.description: Number of certificate requests submitted via the Authority's smartphone application

chatbot.description: Number of certificate requests submitted via the Authority's chatbot

website.description: Number of certificate requests submitted via the Authority's website

good_loan.description: Number of certificate requests related to Good Loan (Qard Hasan) projects

call_center.description: Number of certificate requests submitted via the Authority's call center (8008222)

service_center.description: Number of certificate requests submitted in person at the Authority's service delivery center

mobile_website.description: Number of certificate requests submitted via the Authority's mobile website (smartphone browser)

na_legacy.description: Transactions documented on a channel that was subsequently cancelled (legacy/deprecated channel)

total.description: Total certificate requests across all channels for the given month

terms.definition: Refers to a channel that was cancelled but a transaction was documented before cancellation.
The month in which the service was provided.
